0 '**CANON Runner**
1 '* ~~~~~~~~~~~~ *
2 '*   (c)1985    *
3 '*C & L GAUTIER *
4 '****************
5 ' (EXEC &H28A4)
10 CLS:CLEAR 300,&H1B2F
12 DEFINT A-Z:DEFSTR C,H,K
14 PRINT "CANON Runner (c)1985   [C]hargement","   [R]edéfinition"
16 CONSOLE 1,3
18 K=INKEY$:IF K="R" THEN 50 ELSE IF K<>"C" THEN 18
20 CLS:PRINT "Chargement des 40   tableaux en cours...";
22 A=&H1B30:FOR T=1 TO 40
24 FOR I=1 TO 2:READ C
26 FOR J=1 TO 38
28 V=82+ASC(MID$(C,J,1)):POKE A,V:A=A+1:NEXT J,I
30 READ X,Y
32 POKE A,0:POKE A+1,X:POKE A+2,Y:POKE A+3,0:A=A+4
34 NEXT T
36 CONSOLE 0,4:CLS:BEEP 20,4:PRINT "Chargement terminé"
38 POKE 154,&HA4:POKE 155,&H28:FOR I=1 TO 100:NEXT:PAINT
50 CLS:INPUT "Numéro du tableau (1-40) ";N
52 IF N<1 OR N>40 THEN 50
54 CONSOLE 0,4:CLS
56 L=90+10*N:A=&H1B30+(N-1)*80:START$=""
58 FOR I=A TO A+38 STEP 38:C=""
60 FOR J=I TO I+37
62 P=PEEK(J):C=C+CHR$(P-82):NEXT J
64 H=STR$(L)+" DATA"+C+CHR$(13)
68 START$=START$+H:L=L+2:NEXT I
70 X=PEEK(J+1):Y=PEEK(J+2)
72 H=STR$(L)+" DATA"+STR$(X)+","+STR$(Y)+CHR$(13)
74 START$=START$+H
76 H="":C=""
78 START$=START$+"START$="+STRING$(2,34)+":run"+CHR$(13)
80 TIME$="00:00:59":ALM$="////00:01"
82 OFF 1
